author: Mauro Solis
title: Verily has an ambitious strategy to become a key player in t
text:
Verily has an ambitious strategy to become a key player in the health industry, and has reliable partners that will help to make this real. It is a significant bet of Google ( GOOG ) (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) that could start generating serious earnings in the mid-future and disrupt the health industry.
Source: Author's Compilation
Verily has 16 projects divided into four categories, sensors, interventions, Health platforms & population health and precision medicine. These projects at a glance seem unrelated, but a closer look proves that they are closely intertwined. Verily will also help Google's hardware business and leverage other assets Google has invested on. 
General Health Google's plan for general Health starts with a Watch. The Study watch Project developed a Watch with multiple sensors that monitor user's activity by analyzing physiological and environmental data. It is the key for Google to have information to use, which is what Google does best.
Source: Verily 
If Verily decides to make the Study Watch available for sale or launch a commercial version, it could be the nail that seals the coffin for Fitbit ( FIT ). It has impressive capabilities, and Verily has a much stronger health platform than Fitbit, even with Fitbit's acquisition of Twine health, Verily could outrun them. The watch capabilities could also be incorporated into a Google Watch or Android Wearable to give an edge vs. Apple ( AAPL ) wearables. It will be interesting to see if Project Jacquard will be integrated to provide more comprehensive data gathering.
